predictions.articleTitle: Sireți vs Petrocub Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Low Block Hold Out Without Covali?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Petrocub's 1.89 goals-per-match attack and 0.89 goals-conceded defence justify backing an Away Win over Covali-less Sireți, anchored around a controlled 0:2 victory.

Secondary Under 2.5 Goals angle supported by the 52.3% Poisson baseline and Sireți's 0.78 home-blocked scoring floor (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Covali's defensive suspension tests Sireți's home low block against Petrocub.

score.comment: 0:2 reflects Petrocub's superior attacking depth against a depleted home backline, while 1:2 covers a single Borovschi counter exploiting David's suspension.

goals.comment: Two total goals lead the Poisson distribution at 25.2% via a 0:2 shutout, while three goals follow at 21.7% if Sireți grab a consolation in a 1:2 loss.

bqc.comment: Sireți's deep low block and Petrocub's post-break rhythm point to a level half-time before a second-half away breakthrough, with an early away strike as the main alternative.
